# STABLE GENES 

## Within class 
```{r}
stable_genes_summarized <- read.csv("RNA-based Recovery Score Final/Selected_Stable_Genes(46)_Summarized_DEA_Stats.csv") %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene, Expression_Direction)

ED_up_genes <- stable_genes_summarized %>% filter(Expression_Direction == "Higher_ED") %>% pull(Gene)
M6_up_genes <- stable_genes_summarized %>% filter(Expression_Direction == "Higher_6M") %>% pull(Gene)

rrs_groups <- RRS_df_median_2wk %>%
  mutate(PID = as.character(PID)) %>%
  dplyr::select(PID, RRS_median_group)

meta_2wk_RRS <- metadata_ICs_2wk %>%
  left_join(rrs_groups, by = "PID") 

RNA_2wk_RRS <- RNA_log2_2wk %>%
    mutate(PID = as.character(PID)) %>%
  left_join(meta_2wk_RRS, by = c("INVENTORY.CODE", "PID")) %>%
  dplyr::select("INVENTORY.CODE", "PID", "Timepoint", "RRS_median_group", all_of(c(ED_up_genes, M6_up_genes)))

RRS_genes_wk2_df <- RNA_2wk_RRS %>%
  mutate(ED_up = rowMeans(dplyr::select(., all_of(ED_up_genes)), na.rm = TRUE),
         M6_up = rowMeans(dplyr::select(., all_of(M6_up_genes)), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  dplyr::select(PID, Timepoint, RRS_median_group, ED_up, M6_up) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(ED_up, M6_up), names_to = "Signature", values_to = "Sum") %>%
  mutate(Signature = recode(Signature, ED_up = "ED-Up Genes", M6_up = "6M-Up Genes"),
    Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, levels = c("ED", "WK2", "M6")),
    RRS_median_group = factor(RRS_median_group, levels = c("Low_RRS", "High_RRS"))) %>%
  mutate(Signature = factor(Signature, levels = c("ED-Up Genes", "6M-Up Genes")))

RRS_genes_wk2_wide <- RRS_genes_wk2_df %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(PID, RRS_median_group, Signature),
    names_from = Timepoint,
    values_from = Sum) %>%
  mutate(
    delta_ED_WK2 = WK2 - ED,
    delta_WK2_M6 = M6 - WK2, 
    delta_ED_M6 = M6 - ED)


intervals <- tribble(
  ~Comparison,   ~time1, ~time2,
  "ED_vs_WK2",   "ED",   "WK2",
  "WK2_vs_M6",   "WK2",  "M6",
  "ED_vs_M6",    "ED",   "M6")

rrs_genes_interval_results <- purrr::map_dfr(
  seq_len(nrow(intervals)),
  function(i) {
    comp  <- intervals$Comparison[i]
    time1 <- intervals$time1[i]
    time2 <- intervals$time2[i]

    RRS_genes_wk2_wide %>%
      dplyr::group_by(RRS_median_group, Signature) %>%
      group_modify(~ run_paired_interval_test(.x, time1, time2)) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      mutate(
        Comparison = comp,
        .before = 1
      )
  }
) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(RRS_median_group, Comparison) %>%
  mutate(FDR = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(RRS_median_group = factor(RRS_median_group, levels = c("High_RRS", "Low_RRS")),
         Comparison = factor(Comparison, levels = c("ED_vs_WK2", "WK2_vs_M6", "ED_vs_M6"))) %>%
  arrange(Signature, Comparison)


write.csv(rrs_genes_interval_results, "2WK Analyses/RRS Genes/Within Group Longitudinal Tests/EDWK2M6_RRS_gene_within_class_results.csv")

```

## Between class 
```{r}

rrs_genes_delta_results <- purrr::map_dfr(
  unique(RRS_genes_wk2_wide$Signature),
  function(sig) {

    df_ct <- RRS_genes_wk2_wide %>% filter(Signature == sig)

    bind_rows(
      run_delta_test(df_ct, "delta_ED_WK2") %>%
        mutate(Comparison = "ED_vs_WK2"),
      run_delta_test(df_ct, "delta_WK2_M6") %>%
        mutate(Comparison = "WK2_vs_M6"), 
      run_delta_test(df_ct, "delta_ED_M6") %>%
        mutate(Comparison = "ED_vs_M6")) %>%
      mutate(Signature = sig, .before = 1)
  }) %>%
  group_by(Signature) %>%
  mutate(FDR = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Comparison = factor(Comparison, levels = c("ED_vs_WK2", "WK2_vs_M6", "ED_vs_M6"))) %>%
  arrange(Signature, Comparison) %>%
  dplyr::select(Signature, Comparison, everything())


write.csv(rrs_genes_delta_results, "2WK Analyses/RRS Genes/Between Group Change Score Tests/EDWK2M6_RRS_gene_between_class_results.csv")

```

## Figure 6a
```{r}
plot_df <- RRS_genes_wk2_df %>%
  group_by(Signature, RRS_median_group, Timepoint) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(Sum, na.rm = TRUE),
            se = sd(Sum, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()), 
            .groups = "drop")

stable_genes_line <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(Timepoint, mean, color = RRS_median_group, group = RRS_median_group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se), width = 0.08) +
  facet_wrap(~Signature, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Low_RRS" = "#8D1946", "High_RRS" = "#2A93B5"), 
                     labels = c("Low_RRS" = "Low RRS", "High_RRS" = "High RRS")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Σ Expression", color = NULL) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4, alpha = 1))) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "plain", margin = margin (b = 10)),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y.left = element_text(color = "black", size = 14, margin = margin(r = 1)),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.position = "none",
    legend.margin = margin(t = -12),
    legend.box.margin = margin(t = -12),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey95", linewidth = 0.8),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8), 
    plot.margin = margin(r = 30))

```

## Figure 6a v2 
```{r}
plot_df <- RRS_genes_wk2_df %>%
  mutate(
    Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, levels = c("ED", "WK2", "M6")),
    time_days = case_when(
      Timepoint == "ED" ~ 25,
      Timepoint == "WK2" ~ 50,
      Timepoint == "M6" ~ 160
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Signature, RRS_median_group, Timepoint, time_days) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(Sum, na.rm = TRUE),
            se = sd(Sum, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(Sum))), 
            .groups = "drop")

stable_genes_line <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = time_days, y = mean, 
                                         color = RRS_median_group, 
                                         group = RRS_median_group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 2) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se), 
                width = 4, linewidth = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~Signature, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Low_RRS" = "#8D1946", "High_RRS" = "#2A93B5"), 
                     labels = c("Low_RRS" = "Low RRS", "High_RRS" = "High RRS")) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 180),
    breaks = c(25, 50, 160),
    labels = c(" ", " ", " "),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.04, 0.04))
  ) +
  labs(x = " ", y = "Σ Expression", color = NULL) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4, alpha = 1))) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "plain", margin = margin(b = 10)),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y.left = element_text(color = "black", size = 14, margin = margin(r = 1)),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.position = "none",
    legend.margin = margin(t = -12),
    legend.box.margin = margin(t = -12),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey95", linewidth = 0.8),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8), 
    plot.margin = margin(r = 30)
  )

```
